description: This file defines an interface 'ReportSearchFilterParams' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report'. The interface declares methods related to retrieving report filtering parameters such as report ID, sort order, sort field, limit, and offset, likely used for searching or filtering reports within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: An interface defining methods to access search filtering parameters for reports, such as report ID, sort order, sort field, limit, and offset.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the report ID as an integer.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order string, see 'FilterParams::getSortOrder'.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the sort field as a string or null, see 'FilterParams::getSortField'.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit as an integer, see 'FilterParams::getLimit'.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset as an integer, see 'FilterParams::getOffset'.
